purpose: Historical CPU retrieval development only; not prospective Memory A-I or medical guidance.

licenses.abstract_database: ODC-By-1.0 per upstream LICENSE.md; individual content rights are not blanket relicensed
licenses.code: new local code; no upstream scripts executed
licenses.redistribution: Do not publish abstract/citation text or archives; release own code, hashes, IDs, aggregate results with attribution only.

data_identity_rule: latest URL is mutable, so downloaded response bytes, ETag/Last-Modified, file hashes and semantic counts must be sealed before worker runs; do not imply repo SHA fixes the S3 dataset.

grouping.universe: official labeled train+dev only; do not use hidden test labels
union_rules: same source s2orc_id from claims-with-citances mapping
shared cited_doc_ids or evidence doc IDs
grouping.claim_normalization: lowercase Unicode words joined by single space
grouping.missing_source_rule: quarantine any connected component with a claim lacking source-paper mapping; report counts, never replace or silently count independent
grouping.split: SHA256(seed NUL sorted claim IDs joined by comma) modulo 5 == 0 heldout; all others development; never tune using heldout
grouping.independence: observed paper/citation components only; unobserved shared study/lab/pretraining ancestry remains unknown

lexical.tokenization: Unicode word regex, lowercase; no stemming or stopword removal

graph.kind: corpus-only typed lexical incidence, not semantic or learned GraphRAG
graph.edges: term present in field, token length>=3, document frequency in that field 2..50; title cap8/abstract cap16 per doc ranked by ascending df then token
graph.walk: BM25 top5 seeds; each selected feature contributes 1/(seed_rank * number_of_seed_features * feature_document_degree), self-return excluded
graph.fusion: RRF k60, weight1 BM25 plus weight1 graph; graph scores and ranks descending with doc ID tie break
graph.negative_control: permutation over corpus IDs sorted by SHA256(seed NUL doc_id), conjugate document incidence; preserves graph degree distribution but not document identity

reader_boundary.reader: NONE; never infer entailment/answer correctness from retrieval
reader_boundary.context: top5 docs, up to8 query-overlap-ranked abstract sentences per doc, global4096 UTF-8 bytes including rendered doc_id/sentence_id prefixes; whole sentences only
reader_boundary.rationale: same fixed sentence packer for every arm; score actual retained sentence IDs; no gold-aware packing

metrics.population: heldout claims with annotated evidence; no-evidence claims reported separately and not labeled false
metrics.grouping: report claim micro and observed-family macro, paired differences vs BM25; no significance/advantage claim on historical developer-known data

freeze: This plan hash written before data fetch; code/data material seal before retrieval; preserve raw failures and results; no post-outcome tuning.
